sourceOrigin: Explicitly authorized one-time V24 test publication of the current V25 working snapshot. Includes OCR automatic-versus-human queue separation, missing-invoice-number review example, shared editor/chat/preview improvements, restored Processing label in My tasks, and a Processed-only accountant register requiring organization assignment. Includes current help, settings and payment UI changes. V25 remains the only development workspace. Original source workspaces and prior release tags are unchanged.

notes: Full suite is not fully green. Exact failures and differences from V24.0.6 are retained in local release evidence. Targeted OCR workflow, register, status, chat and help tests passed. No claim that all additional failures are pre-existing.

checks.browser: Local V25 verified: My tasks Processing label, missing required number, no header Chat button, retained Chat tab, completed Documents register with No buyer count zero. Public verification recorded separately.

limitations: Frontend demonstration only; no secure backend authentication or shared production database.
Bank connection, payment sending, accounting transfer, OCR and email APIs are not connected.
Local .env, shared-data files, credentials and node_modules are excluded.
Pages versions on the same domain may share browser storage; use a separate browser profile for isolated testing.
